title: Ankhorage AI
summary: Provider-aware tooling for previewing, applying, inspecting, and rolling back agentic development setup.
purpose: Give standalone projects a controlled CLI for managed AI artifacts and development workflows without silently installing or trusting external agents, hooks, plugins, or MCP servers.
responsibilities: Build and apply repository-managed AI configuration artifacts.
Inspect status and roll back managed setup changes.
Expose planning, execution, review, fixing, shipping, discussion, and setup workflows through Ankh CLI capabilities.
Catalog supported agents, skills, hooks, plugins, and MCP configuration for explicit user selection.
boundaries: Does not silently install or trust providers, hooks, plugins, agents, or MCP servers.
Does not own the external providers it configures.
Does not modify files outside the artifacts recorded as managed by this package.
audience: Developers preparing Ankhorage or standalone repositories for agent-assisted workflows.
Automation invoking preview-first AI setup and inspection commands.
useCases: Preview and initialize managed AI project files.
Synchronize or roll back previously managed artifacts.
Inspect configuration health before enabling an agent workflow.
Discover available agent, skill, plugin, hook, or MCP setup options.

architecture.role: Tooling package with deterministic managed-artifact policy behind CLI delivery commands.
invariants: Setup remains preview-first and changes only package-owned managed artifacts.
Execution and external integrations remain opt-in and explicitly configured.

platforms: Node.js 24-compatible runtimes with Bun for the managed command workflow.
security: External hooks, plugins, MCP servers, and agent execution require explicit trusted configuration.
